306	    def _convert_samples_to_train_data(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
307	        """
308	        Convert inference generated samples to training data.
309	        """
310	        if self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func is not None:
311	            return self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func(self.args, samples)
312	
313	        raw_rewards, rewards = self._post_process_rewards(samples)
314	
315	        assert len(raw_rewards) == len(samples)
316	        assert len(rewards) == len(samples)
317	
318	        rollout_ids = [sample.rollout_id for sample in samples]
319	        existed_rollout_id_values = set(rid for rid in rollout_ids if rid is not None)
320	        tmp_id = 0
321	        for i in range(len(rollout_ids)):
322	            if rollout_ids[i] is None:
323	                while tmp_id in existed_rollout_id_values:
324	                    tmp_id += 1
325	                rollout_ids[i] = tmp_id
326	                existed_rollout_id_values.add(tmp_id)
327	
328	        train_data = {
329	            "tokens": [sample.tokens for sample in samples],
330	            "response_lengths": [sample.response_length for sample in samples],
331	            # some reward model, e.g. remote rm, may return multiple rewards,
332	            # we could use key to select the reward.
333	            "rewards": rewards,
334	            "raw_reward": raw_rewards,
335	            "truncated": [1 if sample.status == Sample.Status.TRUNCATED else 0 for sample in samples],
336	            "sample_indices": [sample.index for sample in samples],
337	            "rollout_ids": rollout_ids,
338	        }
339	
340	        # loss mask
341	        # TODO: compress the loss mask
342	        loss_masks = []
343	        for sample in samples:
344	            # always instantiate loss_mask if not provided
345	            if sample.loss_mask is None:
346	                sample.loss_mask = [1] * sample.response_length
347	
348	            assert (
349	                len(sample.loss_mask) == sample.response_length
350	            ), f"loss mask length {len(sample.loss_mask)} != response length {sample.response_length}"
351	            if sample.remove_sample:
352	                sample.loss_mask = [0] * sample.response_length
353	            loss_masks.append(sample.loss_mask)
354	        train_data["loss_masks"] = loss_masks
355	
356	        # Per-rollout aggregate, precomputed at the step level (where we can
357	        # see every sample of every rollout) and broadcast per-sample so the
358	        # per-mb loss reducer uses the correct whole-rollout denominator even
359	        # when a rollout's samples land in different micro-batches (first-fit
360	        # packing can split a rollout across mbs):
361	        #
362	        #   ``rollout_mask_sums[i]`` — sum of loss-mask totals over every
363	        #   sample in sample i's rollout. Used as the reducer's denominator
364	        #   so summing partial contributions across mbs yields one
365	        #   token-weighted mean per rollout.
366	        rollout_id_list = train_data["rollout_ids"]
367	        mask_sums_per_sample = [sum(m) for m in loss_masks]
368	        rollout_total_mask: dict[int, int] = {}
369	        for rid, ms in zip(rollout_id_list, mask_sums_per_sample, strict=True):
370	            rollout_total_mask[rid] = rollout_total_mask.get(rid, 0) + ms
371	        train_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = [rollout_total_mask[rid] for rid in rollout_id_list]
372	
373	        # Overwrite raw_reward when available. Mixed-source batches may only
374	        # populate this field for a subset of samples (e.g. SWE but not code).
375	        if any(sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata for sample in samples):
376	            train_data["raw_reward"] = [
377	                sample.metadata["raw_reward"] if sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata else sample.reward
378	                for sample in samples
379	            ]
380	
381	        # For rollout buffer
382	        if samples[0].metadata and "round_number" in samples[0].metadata:
383	            train_data["round_number"] = [sample.metadata["round_number"] for sample in samples]
384	
385	        # Add rollout log probabilities for off-policy correction
386	        if samples[0].rollout_log_probs is not None:
387	            train_data["rollout_log_probs"] = [sample.rollout_log_probs for sample in samples]
388	
389	        if getattr(self.args, "rollout_top_p", 1.0) != 1.0:
390	            for sample in samples:
391	                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids is not None
392	                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets is not None
393	                assert len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets) == sample.response_length + 1, (
394	                    f"top-p token offsets length {len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets)} "
395	                    f"!= response length + 1 {sample.response_length + 1}"
396	                )
397	                offset_end = int(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets[-1])
398	                assert offset_end == len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids), (
399	                    f"top-p token offsets[-1] {offset_end} "
400	                    f"!= token ids length {len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids)}"
401	                )
402	            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_ids"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids for sample in samples]
403	            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_offsets"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets for sample in samples]
404	
405	        if samples[0].rollout_routed_experts is not None:
406	            routed_experts = [torch.as_tensor(sample.rollout_routed_experts) for sample in samples]
407	            if getattr(self.args, "use_rollout_routing_replay", False):
408	                validate_rollout_routed_experts_for_replay(routed_experts, self.args)
409	            train_data["rollout_routed_experts"] = routed_experts
410	
411	        if samples[0].train_metadata is not None:
412	            train_data["metadata"] = [sample.train_metadata for sample in samples]
413	
414	        if any(sample.multimodal_train_inputs is not None for sample in samples):
415	            train_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [sample.multimodal_train_inputs for sample in samples]
416	
417	        if samples[0].teacher_log_probs is not None:
418	            train_data["teacher_log_probs"] = [sample.teacher_log_probs for sample in samples]
419	
420	        if samples[0].metadata is not None:
421	            train_data["source_names"] = [get_source(sample) for sample in samples]

423	        return train_data

428	    def _split_train_data_by_dp(self, data):
429	        """Compute the DP/mbs schedule and package each rank's rollout_data
430	        into a Ray Box. The schedule itself is computed by
431	        :func:`build_dp_schedule` so it stays unit-testable without Ray/sglang.
432	
433	        Step split is by rollout id (``samples[i].rollout_id``, falling back
434	        to ``samples[i].index``); each step holds exactly
435	        ``args.global_batch_size`` rollouts so the training-step count per
436	        rollout is fixed at ``rollout_batch_size * n_samples_per_prompt //
437	        global_batch_size`` regardless of how many training samples each
438	        rollout produced.
439	        """
440	        dp_size = self.train_parallel_config["dp_size"]
441	        total_lengths = [len(t) for t in data["tokens"]]
442	        data["total_lengths"] = total_lengths
443	
444	        partitions, micro_batch_indices, num_microbatches, global_batch_sizes = build_dp_schedule(
445	            self.args,
446	            self.train_parallel_config,
447	            total_lengths,
448	            global_batch_size=self.args.global_batch_size,
449	            rollout_indices=data["rollout_ids"],
450	        )
451	
452	        # Package per-rank rollout_data
453	        rollout_data_refs = []
454	        for r in range(dp_size):
455	            partition = partitions[r]
456	            rollout_data = {"partition": partition}
457	            for key in [
458	                "tokens",
459	                "multimodal_train_inputs",
460	                "response_lengths",
461	                "rewards",
462	                "truncated",
463	                "loss_masks",
464	                "round_number",
465	                "sample_indices",
466	                "rollout_ids",
467	                "rollout_mask_sums",
468	                "rollout_log_probs",
469	                "rollout_top_p_token_ids",
470	                "rollout_top_p_token_offsets",
471	                "rollout_routed_experts",
472	                "source_names",
473	                "prompt",
474	                "teacher_log_probs",
475	            ]:
476	                if key not in data:
477	                    continue
478	                rollout_data[key] = [data[key][j] for j in partition]
479	            # keys that need to be splited at train side
480	            for key in ["raw_reward", "total_lengths"]:
481	                if key not in data:
482	                    continue
483	                rollout_data[key] = data[key]
484	            rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"] = global_batch_sizes
485	            rollout_data["num_microbatches"] = num_microbatches
486	            rollout_data["micro_batch_indices"] = micro_batch_indices[r]
487	            tensorize_rollout_data_for_training(rollout_data)
488	            transport = getattr(self.args, "rollout_data_transport", "object-store")
489	            if transport == "nixl":
490	                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data, _tensor_transport="nixl")))
491	            elif transport == "object-store":
492	                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data)))
493	            else:
494	                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported rollout data transport: {transport!r}")
495	        return rollout_data_refs

import itertools
import logging
import time
from typing import Any

import ray
import torch

from slime.backends.sglang_utils.deployment import start_rollout_servers
from slime.observability import logging_utils
from slime.observability.logging_utils import configure_logger, init_tracking
from slime.observability.rollout_data_utils import (
    load_debug_rollout_data,
    save_debug_rollout_data,
    tensorize_rollout_data_for_training,
    validate_rollout_id_annotated,
    validate_rollout_routed_experts_for_replay,
)
from slime.observability.rollout_metrics import log_eval_rollout_data, log_rollout_data
from slime.rollout.base_types import call_rollout_fn
from slime.rollout.sample_hooks import set_current_rollout_id
from slime.utils.data import get_source
from slime.utils.dp_schedule import build_dp_schedule
from slime.utils.health_monitor import RolloutHealthMonitor
from slime.utils.http_utils import init_http_client
from slime.utils.misc import Box, load_function
from slime.utils.types import Sample

from .utils import Lock, add_default_ray_env_vars

logging.getLogger("httpx").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
logging.getLogger("httpcore").setLevel(logging.WARNING)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@ray.remote
class RolloutManager:
    """The class to run rollout and convert rollout data to training data."""

    def __init__(self, args, pg):
        configure_logger()

        self.pg = pg
        self.args = args

        rollout_init_handles: list[Any] = []
        if self.args.debug_train_only:
            self.servers: dict[str, Any] = {}
        else:
            init_http_client(args)
            self.servers, rollout_init_handles = start_rollout_servers(args, pg)

        data_source_cls = load_function(self.args.data_source_path)
        self.data_source = data_source_cls(args)

        self.generate_rollout = load_function(self.args.rollout_function_path)
        self.eval_generate_rollout = load_function(self.args.eval_function_path)
        self.custom_reward_post_process_func = None
        if self.args.custom_reward_post_process_path is not None:
            self.custom_reward_post_process_func = load_function(self.args.custom_reward_post_process_path)
        self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func = None
        if self.args.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_path is not None:
            self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func = load_function(
                self.args.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_path
            )
        logger.info(f"import {self.args.rollout_function_path} as generate_rollout function.")
        logger.info(f"import {self.args.eval_function_path} as eval_generate_rollout function.")

        if rollout_init_handles:
            ray.get(rollout_init_handles)

        init_tracking(args, primary=False)
        self.rollout_engine_lock = Lock.options(
            num_cpus=1,
            num_gpus=0,
            runtime_env={"env_vars": add_default_ray_env_vars()},
        ).remote()
        self.rollout_id = -1

        self._health_monitors = []
        if not self.args.debug_train_only and self.args.use_fault_tolerance:
            for srv in self.servers.values():
                for group in srv.server_groups:
                    monitor = RolloutHealthMonitor(group, args)
                    monitor.start()
                    self._health_monitors.append(monitor)
            self._ci_fault_injection_pending = self.args.ci_test  # Flag for CI fault injection

    def _try_ci_fault_injection(self):
        """Try to inject fault during generate (when health monitor is running)."""
        if not self._ci_fault_injection_pending:
            return

        # Only inject fault once
        self._ci_fault_injection_pending = False

        if (
            self.server
            and self.server.server_groups
            and self.server.server_groups[0].all_engines
            and self.server.server_groups[0].all_engines[0]
        ):
            logger.info("CI Fault Injection: Simulating crash on engine 0 during generate")
            try:
                # This will cause the ray actor to exit
                self.server.server_groups[0].all_engines[0].simulate_crash.remote()
                # Wait for health monitor to detect the crash and mark engine as None
                # health_check_interval + health_check_timeout + buffer
                wait_time = self.args.rollout_health_check_interval + self.args.rollout_health_check_timeout + 5
                logger.info(f"CI Fault Injection: Waiting {wait_time}s for health monitor to detect crash")
                time.sleep(wait_time)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"CI Fault Injection failed: {e}")

    def dispose(self):
        for monitor in self._health_monitors:
            monitor.stop()
        logging_utils.finish_tracking(self.args)

    @property
    def server(self) -> Any | None:
        """Default server (first model).  For backward compatibility."""
        if not self.servers:
            return None
        return next(iter(self.servers.values()))

    def _get_updatable_server(self) -> Any | None:
        """Return the server with ``update_weights=True``.

        When multiple updatable servers exist, returns the first one
        (multi-model weight update is not yet supported).
        """
        for srv in self.servers.values():
            if srv.update_weights:
                return srv
        return None

    @property
    def rollout_engines(self):
        """All node-0 engines across all servers / models."""
        return [e for srv in self.servers.values() for e in srv.engines]

    def get_updatable_engines_and_lock(self):
        """Return engines eligible for weight updates.

        Returns engines from the first model that has
        ``update_weights=True``.  Frozen models (reference, reward,
        etc.) are automatically excluded.
        """
        srv = self._get_updatable_server()
        engines = srv.engines if srv else []
        gpu_counts = srv.engine_gpu_counts if srv else []
        gpu_offsets = srv.engine_gpu_offsets if srv else []
        parallel_configs = srv.engine_parallel_configs if srv else []
        num_new = srv.num_new_engines if srv else 0
        return engines, self.rollout_engine_lock, num_new, gpu_counts, gpu_offsets, parallel_configs

    def get_num_rollout_per_epoch(self):
        assert self.args.rollout_global_dataset
        return len(self.data_source) // self.args.rollout_batch_size

    def generate(self, rollout_id):
        start_time = time.time()
        self.rollout_id = rollout_id
        set_current_rollout_id(rollout_id)
        self.health_monitoring_resume()
        if self.args.ci_test and self.args.use_fault_tolerance and rollout_id >= 2:
            self._try_ci_fault_injection()
        data, metrics = self._get_rollout_data(rollout_id=rollout_id)
        save_debug_rollout_data(
            self.args.save_debug_rollout_data,
            data,
            rollout_id=rollout_id,
            evaluation=False,
        )
        log_rollout_data(rollout_id, self.args, data, metrics, time.time() - start_time)
        if self.args.debug_rollout_only:
            # if debug rollout only, we don't convert samples to train data and directly return
            return
        data = self._convert_samples_to_train_data(data)
        return self._split_train_data_by_dp(data)

    def eval(self, rollout_id):
        if self.args.debug_train_only:
            # if debug train only, we don't generate evaluation data
            return
        set_current_rollout_id(rollout_id)
        self.health_monitoring_resume()

        result = call_rollout_fn(self.eval_generate_rollout, self.args, rollout_id, self.data_source, evaluation=True)
        data = result.data
        save_debug_rollout_data(
            self.args.save_debug_rollout_data,
            data,
            rollout_id=rollout_id,
            evaluation=True,
        )
        log_eval_rollout_data(rollout_id, self.args, data, result.metrics)

    def save(self, rollout_id):
        self.data_source.save(rollout_id)

    def load(self, rollout_id=None):
        self.data_source.load(rollout_id)

    def offload(self):
        self.health_monitoring_pause()
        for srv in self.servers.values():
            srv.offload()

    def onload(self, tags: list[str] | None = None):
        for srv in self.servers.values():
            srv.onload(tags)

    def onload_weights(self):
        for srv in self.servers.values():
            srv.onload_weights()

    def onload_kv(self):
        for srv in self.servers.values():
            srv.onload_kv()

    def recover_updatable_engines(self):
        """Restart dead updatable rollout engines before the next weight update.

        Recovers the updatable model (the one that receives weight
        updates from training).
        """
        self.health_monitoring_pause()
        srv = self._get_updatable_server()
        if self.rollout_id == -1 or srv is None:
            return

        srv.recover()

    def clear_updatable_num_new_engines(self):
        # when fault tolerance is not enabled, we need to manually clear num_new_engines after update_weights
        srv = self._get_updatable_server()
        if srv:
            srv.num_new_engines = 0

    def health_monitoring_pause(self) -> None:
        for monitor in self._health_monitors:
            monitor.pause()

    def health_monitoring_resume(self) -> None:
        for monitor in self._health_monitors:
            monitor.resume()

    def check_weights(self, action: str):
        return ray.get([engine.check_weights.remote(action=action) for engine in self.rollout_engines])

    def _get_rollout_data(self, rollout_id):
        if self.args.load_debug_rollout_data:
            data = load_debug_rollout_data(
                self.args.load_debug_rollout_data,
                rollout_id=rollout_id,
                subsample_ratio=self.args.load_debug_rollout_data_subsample,
            )
            metrics = None
        else:
            data = call_rollout_fn(self.generate_rollout, self.args, rollout_id, self.data_source, evaluation=False)
            metrics = data.metrics
            data = data.samples
            # Enforce the rollout_id contract before flattening: any list[Sample]
            # encountered in the nested output must have rollout_id set on every
            # element. Default rollouts inherit it from the data source; compact /
            # subagent paths that split one rollout into N training samples must
            # set the same rollout_id on every sibling so the loss reducer counts
            # the rollout once instead of N times.
            validate_rollout_id_annotated(data)
            # flatten the data if it is a list of lists
            while isinstance(data[0], list):
                data = list(itertools.chain.from_iterable(data))

        return data, metrics

    def _post_process_rewards(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
        if self.custom_reward_post_process_func is not None:
            return self.custom_reward_post_process_func(self.args, samples)

        raw_rewards = [sample.get_reward_value(self.args) for sample in samples]
        if (
            self.args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo", "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline"]
            and self.args.rewards_normalization
        ):
            # group norm
            rewards = torch.tensor(raw_rewards, dtype=torch.float)
            if rewards.shape[-1] == self.args.n_samples_per_prompt * self.args.rollout_batch_size:
                rewards = rewards.reshape(-1, self.args.n_samples_per_prompt)
            else:
                # when samples count are not equal in each group
                rewards = rewards.view(-1, rewards.shape[-1])
            mean = rewards.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            rewards = rewards - mean

            if self.args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo"] and self.args.grpo_std_normalization:
                std = rewards.std(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                rewards = rewards / (std + 1e-6)

            return raw_rewards, rewards.flatten().tolist()

        return raw_rewards, raw_rewards

    def _convert_samples_to_train_data(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
        """
        Convert inference generated samples to training data.
        """
        if self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func is not None:
            return self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func(self.args, samples)

        raw_rewards, rewards = self._post_process_rewards(samples)

        assert len(raw_rewards) == len(samples)
        assert len(rewards) == len(samples)

        rollout_ids = [sample.rollout_id for sample in samples]
        existed_rollout_id_values = set(rid for rid in rollout_ids if rid is not None)
        tmp_id = 0
        for i in range(len(rollout_ids)):
            if rollout_ids[i] is None:
                while tmp_id in existed_rollout_id_values:
                    tmp_id += 1
                rollout_ids[i] = tmp_id
                existed_rollout_id_values.add(tmp_id)

        train_data = {
            "tokens": [sample.tokens for sample in samples],
            "response_lengths": [sample.response_length for sample in samples],
            # some reward model, e.g. remote rm, may return multiple rewards,
            # we could use key to select the reward.
            "rewards": rewards,
            "raw_reward": raw_rewards,
            "truncated": [1 if sample.status == Sample.Status.TRUNCATED else 0 for sample in samples],
            "sample_indices": [sample.index for sample in samples],
            "rollout_ids": rollout_ids,
        }

        # loss mask
        # TODO: compress the loss mask
        loss_masks = []
        for sample in samples:
            # always instantiate loss_mask if not provided
            if sample.loss_mask is None:
                sample.loss_mask = [1] * sample.response_length

            assert (
                len(sample.loss_mask) == sample.response_length
            ), f"loss mask length {len(sample.loss_mask)} != response length {sample.response_length}"
            if sample.remove_sample:
                sample.loss_mask = [0] * sample.response_length
            loss_masks.append(sample.loss_mask)
        train_data["loss_masks"] = loss_masks

        # Per-rollout aggregate, precomputed at the step level (where we can
        # see every sample of every rollout) and broadcast per-sample so the
        # per-mb loss reducer uses the correct whole-rollout denominator even
        # when a rollout's samples land in different micro-batches (first-fit
        # packing can split a rollout across mbs):
        #
        #   ``rollout_mask_sums[i]`` — sum of loss-mask totals over every
        #   sample in sample i's rollout. Used as the reducer's denominator
        #   so summing partial contributions across mbs yields one
        #   token-weighted mean per rollout.
        rollout_id_list = train_data["rollout_ids"]
        mask_sums_per_sample = [sum(m) for m in loss_masks]
        rollout_total_mask: dict[int, int] = {}
        for rid, ms in zip(rollout_id_list, mask_sums_per_sample, strict=True):
            rollout_total_mask[rid] = rollout_total_mask.get(rid, 0) + ms
        train_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = [rollout_total_mask[rid] for rid in rollout_id_list]

        # Overwrite raw_reward when available. Mixed-source batches may only
        # populate this field for a subset of samples (e.g. SWE but not code).
        if any(sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata for sample in samples):
            train_data["raw_reward"] = [
                sample.metadata["raw_reward"] if sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata else sample.reward
                for sample in samples
            ]

        # For rollout buffer
        if samples[0].metadata and "round_number" in samples[0].metadata:
            train_data["round_number"] = [sample.metadata["round_number"] for sample in samples]

        # Add rollout log probabilities for off-policy correction
        if samples[0].rollout_log_probs is not None:
            train_data["rollout_log_probs"] = [sample.rollout_log_probs for sample in samples]

        if getattr(self.args, "rollout_top_p", 1.0) != 1.0:
            for sample in samples:
                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids is not None
                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets is not None
                assert len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets) == sample.response_length + 1, (
                    f"top-p token offsets length {len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets)} "
                    f"!= response length + 1 {sample.response_length + 1}"
                )
                offset_end = int(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets[-1])
                assert offset_end == len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids), (
                    f"top-p token offsets[-1] {offset_end} "
                    f"!= token ids length {len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids)}"
                )
            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_ids"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids for sample in samples]
            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_offsets"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets for sample in samples]

        if samples[0].rollout_routed_experts is not None:
            routed_experts = [torch.as_tensor(sample.rollout_routed_experts) for sample in samples]
            if getattr(self.args, "use_rollout_routing_replay", False):
                validate_rollout_routed_experts_for_replay(routed_experts, self.args)
            train_data["rollout_routed_experts"] = routed_experts

        if samples[0].train_metadata is not None:
            train_data["metadata"] = [sample.train_metadata for sample in samples]

        if any(sample.multimodal_train_inputs is not None for sample in samples):
            train_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [sample.multimodal_train_inputs for sample in samples]

        if samples[0].teacher_log_probs is not None:
            train_data["teacher_log_probs"] = [sample.teacher_log_probs for sample in samples]

        if samples[0].metadata is not None:
            train_data["source_names"] = [get_source(sample) for sample in samples]

        return train_data

    def set_train_parallel_config(self, config: dict):
        self.train_parallel_config = config

    def _split_train_data_by_dp(self, data):
        """Compute the DP/mbs schedule and package each rank's rollout_data
        into a Ray Box. The schedule itself is computed by
        :func:`build_dp_schedule` so it stays unit-testable without Ray/sglang.

        Step split is by rollout id (``samples[i].rollout_id``, falling back
        to ``samples[i].index``); each step holds exactly
        ``args.global_batch_size`` rollouts so the training-step count per
        rollout is fixed at ``rollout_batch_size * n_samples_per_prompt //
        global_batch_size`` regardless of how many training samples each
        rollout produced.
        """
        dp_size = self.train_parallel_config["dp_size"]
        total_lengths = [len(t) for t in data["tokens"]]
        data["total_lengths"] = total_lengths

        partitions, micro_batch_indices, num_microbatches, global_batch_sizes = build_dp_schedule(
            self.args,
            self.train_parallel_config,
            total_lengths,
            global_batch_size=self.args.global_batch_size,
            rollout_indices=data["rollout_ids"],
        )

        # Package per-rank rollout_data
        rollout_data_refs = []
        for r in range(dp_size):
            partition = partitions[r]
            rollout_data = {"partition": partition}
            for key in [
                "tokens",
                "multimodal_train_inputs",
                "response_lengths",
                "rewards",
                "truncated",
                "loss_masks",
                "round_number",
                "sample_indices",
                "rollout_ids",
                "rollout_mask_sums",
                "rollout_log_probs",
                "rollout_top_p_token_ids",
                "rollout_top_p_token_offsets",
                "rollout_routed_experts",
                "source_names",
                "prompt",
                "teacher_log_probs",
            ]:
                if key not in data:
                    continue
                rollout_data[key] = [data[key][j] for j in partition]
            # keys that need to be splited at train side
            for key in ["raw_reward", "total_lengths"]:
                if key not in data:
                    continue
                rollout_data[key] = data[key]
            rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"] = global_batch_sizes
            rollout_data["num_microbatches"] = num_microbatches
            rollout_data["micro_batch_indices"] = micro_batch_indices[r]
            tensorize_rollout_data_for_training(rollout_data)
            transport = getattr(self.args, "rollout_data_transport", "object-store")
            if transport == "nixl":
                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data, _tensor_transport="nixl")))
            elif transport == "object-store":
                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data)))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported rollout data transport: {transport!r}")
        return rollout_data_refs

279	    def _post_process_rewards(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
280	        if self.custom_reward_post_process_func is not None:
281	            return self.custom_reward_post_process_func(self.args, samples)
282	
283	        raw_rewards = [sample.get_reward_value(self.args) for sample in samples]
284	        if (
285	            self.args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo", "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline"]
286	            and self.args.rewards_normalization
287	        ):
288	            # group norm
289	            rewards = torch.tensor(raw_rewards, dtype=torch.float)
290	            if rewards.shape[-1] == self.args.n_samples_per_prompt * self.args.rollout_batch_size:
291	                rewards = rewards.reshape(-1, self.args.n_samples_per_prompt)
292	            else:
293	                # when samples count are not equal in each group
294	                rewards = rewards.view(-1, rewards.shape[-1])
295	            mean = rewards.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
296	            rewards = rewards - mean
297	
298	            if self.args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo"] and self.args.grpo_std_normalization:
299	                std = rewards.std(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
300	                rewards = rewards / (std + 1e-6)

302	            return raw_rewards, rewards.flatten().tolist()

306	    def _convert_samples_to_train_data(self, samples: list[Sample] | list[list[Sample]]):
307	        """
308	        Convert inference generated samples to training data.
309	        """
310	        if self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func is not None:
311	            return self.custom_convert_samples_to_train_data_func(self.args, samples)
312	
313	        raw_rewards, rewards = self._post_process_rewards(samples)
314	
315	        assert len(raw_rewards) == len(samples)
316	        assert len(rewards) == len(samples)
317	
318	        rollout_ids = [sample.rollout_id for sample in samples]
319	        existed_rollout_id_values = set(rid for rid in rollout_ids if rid is not None)
320	        tmp_id = 0
321	        for i in range(len(rollout_ids)):
322	            if rollout_ids[i] is None:
323	                while tmp_id in existed_rollout_id_values:
324	                    tmp_id += 1
325	                rollout_ids[i] = tmp_id
326	                existed_rollout_id_values.add(tmp_id)
327	
328	        train_data = {
329	            "tokens": [sample.tokens for sample in samples],
330	            "response_lengths": [sample.response_length for sample in samples],
331	            # some reward model, e.g. remote rm, may return multiple rewards,
332	            # we could use key to select the reward.
333	            "rewards": rewards,
334	            "raw_reward": raw_rewards,
335	            "truncated": [1 if sample.status == Sample.Status.TRUNCATED else 0 for sample in samples],
336	            "sample_indices": [sample.index for sample in samples],
337	            "rollout_ids": rollout_ids,
338	        }
339	
340	        # loss mask
341	        # TODO: compress the loss mask
342	        loss_masks = []
343	        for sample in samples:
344	            # always instantiate loss_mask if not provided
345	            if sample.loss_mask is None:
346	                sample.loss_mask = [1] * sample.response_length
347	
348	            assert (
349	                len(sample.loss_mask) == sample.response_length
350	            ), f"loss mask length {len(sample.loss_mask)} != response length {sample.response_length}"
351	            if sample.remove_sample:
352	                sample.loss_mask = [0] * sample.response_length
353	            loss_masks.append(sample.loss_mask)
354	        train_data["loss_masks"] = loss_masks
355	
356	        # Per-rollout aggregate, precomputed at the step level (where we can
357	        # see every sample of every rollout) and broadcast per-sample so the
358	        # per-mb loss reducer uses the correct whole-rollout denominator even
359	        # when a rollout's samples land in different micro-batches (first-fit
360	        # packing can split a rollout across mbs):
361	        #
362	        #   ``rollout_mask_sums[i]`` — sum of loss-mask totals over every
363	        #   sample in sample i's rollout. Used as the reducer's denominator
364	        #   so summing partial contributions across mbs yields one
365	        #   token-weighted mean per rollout.
366	        rollout_id_list = train_data["rollout_ids"]
367	        mask_sums_per_sample = [sum(m) for m in loss_masks]
368	        rollout_total_mask: dict[int, int] = {}
369	        for rid, ms in zip(rollout_id_list, mask_sums_per_sample, strict=True):
370	            rollout_total_mask[rid] = rollout_total_mask.get(rid, 0) + ms
371	        train_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = [rollout_total_mask[rid] for rid in rollout_id_list]
372	
373	        # Overwrite raw_reward when available. Mixed-source batches may only
374	        # populate this field for a subset of samples (e.g. SWE but not code).
375	        if any(sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata for sample in samples):
376	            train_data["raw_reward"] = [
377	                sample.metadata["raw_reward"] if sample.metadata and "raw_reward" in sample.metadata else sample.reward
378	                for sample in samples
379	            ]
380	
381	        # For rollout buffer
382	        if samples[0].metadata and "round_number" in samples[0].metadata:
383	            train_data["round_number"] = [sample.metadata["round_number"] for sample in samples]
384	
385	        # Add rollout log probabilities for off-policy correction
386	        if samples[0].rollout_log_probs is not None:
387	            train_data["rollout_log_probs"] = [sample.rollout_log_probs for sample in samples]
388	
389	        if getattr(self.args, "rollout_top_p", 1.0) != 1.0:
390	            for sample in samples:
391	                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids is not None
392	                assert sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets is not None
393	                assert len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets) == sample.response_length + 1, (

396	                )
397	                offset_end = int(sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets[-1])
398	                assert offset_end == len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids), (
399	                    f"top-p token offsets[-1] {offset_end} "
400	                    f"!= token ids length {len(sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids)}"
401	                )
402	            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_ids"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_ids for sample in samples]
403	            train_data["rollout_top_p_token_offsets"] = [sample.rollout_top_p_token_offsets for sample in samples]
404	
405	        if samples[0].rollout_routed_experts is not None:
406	            routed_experts = [torch.as_tensor(sample.rollout_routed_experts) for sample in samples]
407	            if getattr(self.args, "use_rollout_routing_replay", False):

409	            train_data["rollout_routed_experts"] = routed_experts

412	            train_data["metadata"] = [sample.train_metadata for sample in samples]
413	
414	        if any(sample.multimodal_train_inputs is not None for sample in samples):
415	            train_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [sample.multimodal_train_inputs for sample in samples]
416	
417	        if samples[0].teacher_log_probs is not None:

425	    def set_train_parallel_config(self, config: dict):
426	        self.train_parallel_config = config

428	    def _split_train_data_by_dp(self, data):
429	        """Compute the DP/mbs schedule and package each rank's rollout_data
430	        into a Ray Box. The schedule itself is computed by
431	        :func:`build_dp_schedule` so it stays unit-testable without Ray/sglang.
432	
433	        Step split is by rollout id (``samples[i].rollout_id``, falling back
434	        to ``samples[i].index``); each step holds exactly
435	        ``args.global_batch_size`` rollouts so the training-step count per
436	        rollout is fixed at ``rollout_batch_size * n_samples_per_prompt //
437	        global_batch_size`` regardless of how many training samples each
438	        rollout produced.
439	        """
440	        dp_size = self.train_parallel_config["dp_size"]
441	        total_lengths = [len(t) for t in data["tokens"]]
442	        data["total_lengths"] = total_lengths
443	
444	        partitions, micro_batch_indices, num_microbatches, global_batch_sizes = build_dp_schedule(
445	            self.args,
446	            self.train_parallel_config,
447	            total_lengths,
448	            global_batch_size=self.args.global_batch_size,
449	            rollout_indices=data["rollout_ids"],
450	        )
451	
452	        # Package per-rank rollout_data
453	        rollout_data_refs = []
454	        for r in range(dp_size):
455	            partition = partitions[r]
456	            rollout_data = {"partition": partition}
457	            for key in [
458	                "tokens",
459	                "multimodal_train_inputs",
460	                "response_lengths",
461	                "rewards",
462	                "truncated",
463	                "loss_masks",
464	                "round_number",
465	                "sample_indices",
466	                "rollout_ids",
467	                "rollout_mask_sums",
468	                "rollout_log_probs",
469	                "rollout_top_p_token_ids",
470	                "rollout_top_p_token_offsets",
471	                "rollout_routed_experts",
472	                "source_names",
473	                "prompt",
474	                "teacher_log_probs",
475	            ]:
476	                if key not in data:
477	                    continue
478	                rollout_data[key] = [data[key][j] for j in partition]
479	            # keys that need to be splited at train side
480	            for key in ["raw_reward", "total_lengths"]:
481	                if key not in data:
482	                    continue
483	                rollout_data[key] = data[key]
484	            rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"] = global_batch_sizes
485	            rollout_data["num_microbatches"] = num_microbatches
486	            rollout_data["micro_batch_indices"] = micro_batch_indices[r]
487	            tensorize_rollout_data_for_training(rollout_data)
488	            transport = getattr(self.args, "rollout_data_transport", "object-store")
489	            if transport == "nixl":
490	                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data, _tensor_transport="nixl")))
491	            elif transport == "object-store":
492	                rollout_data_refs.append(Box(ray.put(rollout_data)))
493	            else:
494	                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported rollout data transport: {transport!r}")
495	        return rollout_data_refs

return sample

    state = GenerateState(args)

    # generate
    async with state.semaphore:
        if state.aborted:
            sample.status = Sample.Status.ABORTED
            return sample

        with state.dp_rank_context() as _:
            # Check sample.generate_function_path for per-sample custom_generate_function_path (e.g., from eval dataset config)
            custom_func_path = getattr(sample, "generate_function_path", None) or args.custom_generate_function_path

            if custom_func_path is not None:
                custom_generate_func = load_function(custom_func_path)
                # if signature has evaluation, pass evaluation
                if "evaluation" in inspect.signature(custom_generate_func).parameters:
                    sample = await custom_generate_func(args, sample, sampling_params, evaluation=evaluation)
                else:
                    sample = await custom_generate_func(args, sample, sampling_params)
            else:
                sample = await generate(args, sample, sampling_params)

    sample = await apply_rollout_sample_hooks(args, sample, evaluation=evaluation)

    # for the rm that need the whole group, we will not do the rm here
    if args.group_rm:
        return sample

    if isinstance(sample, list):
        samples = sample
        if any(sample.status == Sample.Status.ABORTED for sample in samples):
            return samples

        samples_need_reward = [sample for sample in samples if sample.reward is None]
        with trace_span(samples_need_reward, "reward_model"):
            rewards = await batched_async_rm(args, samples_need_reward)
        for sample, reward in zip(samples_need_reward, rewards, strict=False):
            sample.reward = reward
        return samples
    else:
        if sample.status == Sample.Status.ABORTED:
            return sample
        # Some custom generate paths may have already filled the reward.
        if sample.reward is None:
            with trace_span(sample, "reward_model"):
                sample.reward = await async_rm(args, sample)

    return sample

12	def compute_approx_kl(
13	    log_probs: torch.Tensor,
14	    log_probs_base: torch.Tensor,
15	    kl_loss_type: str,
16	    importance_ratio: torch.Tensor | None = None,
17	) -> torch.Tensor:
18	    """
19	    Compute the approximate KL divergence between two distributions.
20	    Schulman blog: http://joschu.net/blog/kl-approx.html
21	
22	    Args:
23	        log_probs: Log probabilities of the new distribution.
24	        log_probs_base: Log probabilities of the base distribution.
25	        kl_loss_type: Type of KL estimator (k1, k2, k3, low_var_kl).
26	        importance_ratio: Optional IS ratio (π_θ/π_old) for unbiased KL estimation.
27	    """
28	    log_ratio = log_probs.float() - log_probs_base.float()
29	
30	    if kl_loss_type == "k1":
31	        kl = log_ratio
32	    elif kl_loss_type == "k2":
33	        kl = log_ratio**2 / 2.0

35	        # The non negative kl approximation in

37	        # Besides non negative, it is also unbiased and have lower variance.

61	    """Compute Off-Policy Sequence Masking (OPSM) mask.
62	
63	    Args:
64	        args: Configuration containing `opsm_delta` threshold.
65	        full_log_probs: Current policy log-probs per sample.

73	        `opsm_clipfrac` is the count of masked sequences.
74	    """
75	    opsm_mask_list = []
76	    device = advantages[0].device
77	    opsm_clipfrac = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)
78

86	        mask = ((advantage < 0) & (seq_kl > args.opsm_delta)).float()
87	        opsm_clipfrac += mask.sum() / torch.clamp_min(loss_mask.sum(), 1)
88

105	        full_old_log_probs: Old policy log-probs per sample (full or CP-local).
106	        local_log_probs: Local (CP-local) log-probs for expansion shape reference.
107	        loss_masks: Loss masks per sample.

111	        sequence has the same KL value (the sequence-level KL).

113	    # Compute sequence-level KL and expand to per-token
114	    ppo_kl = [
115	        ((old_logprob - log_prob) * loss_mask).sum() / torch.clamp_min(loss_mask.sum(), 1)
116	        for log_prob, old_logprob, loss_mask in zip(full_log_probs, full_old_log_probs, loss_masks, strict=False)
117	    ]
118	    ppo_kl = [kl.expand_as(log_prob) for kl, log_prob in zip(ppo_kl, local_log_probs, strict=False)]

167	    ratio = (-ppo_kl).exp()
168	    ratio_truncated = torch.clamp(ratio, min=1.0 - eps_clip, max=1.0 + eps_clip_high)
169	    pg_losses = -ratio_truncated.detach() * advantages * log_probs
170	    clipfrac = (ratio_truncated != ratio).float()
171	    return pg_losses, clipfrac

187	class _VocabParallelLogProbEntropy(torch.autograd.Function):
188	    @staticmethod
189	    def forward(
190	        ctx,
191	        vocab_parallel_logits: torch.Tensor,
192	        target: torch.Tensor,
193	        log_prob_keep_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
194	        process_group,
195	        with_entropy: bool,
196	        with_entropy_grad: bool,
197	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
198	        with_entropy_grad = with_entropy and with_entropy_grad
199	        vocab_parallel_logits = vocab_parallel_logits.float()
200	        seq_len, vocab_parallel_size = vocab_parallel_logits.shape
201	        rank, _world_size = _get_vocab_parallel_rank_size(process_group)
202	        vocab_start_index = rank * vocab_parallel_size
203	        vocab_end_index = vocab_start_index + vocab_parallel_size
204	
205	        target_mask = (target < vocab_start_index) | (target >= vocab_end_index)
206	        masked_target_1d = (target - vocab_start_index).clone()
207	        masked_target_1d[target_mask] = 0
208	        arange_1d = torch.arange(seq_len, device=vocab_parallel_logits.device)
209	
210	        def vocab_parallel_softmax(
211	            logits: torch.Tensor,
212	            inplace: bool = False,
213	        ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
214	            logits_max = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
215	            _maybe_all_reduce(logits_max, dist.ReduceOp.MAX, process_group)
216	            # Subtract the max for numerical stability. When ``inplace`` is set, the
217	            # caller passed a scratch buffer it owns, so overwrite it instead of
218	            # allocating another [seq_len, vocab] tensor.
219	            normalized_logits = logits.sub_(logits_max) if inplace else logits - logits_max
220	            # The normalized logit at the target position is the log-prob numerator;
221	            # gather it (a small copy) before the in-place ``exp_`` destroys it.
222	            predicted_logits = normalized_logits.view(-1, vocab_parallel_size)[arange_1d, masked_target_1d]
223	            # Reuse the ``normalized_logits`` storage for exp and softmax so the whole
224	            # softmax costs a single [seq_len, vocab] buffer instead of three.
225	            exp_logits = normalized_logits.exp_()
226	            sum_exp_logits = exp_logits.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
227	            _maybe_all_reduce(sum_exp_logits, dist.ReduceOp.SUM, process_group)
228	            softmax = exp_logits.div_(sum_exp_logits)
229	            return predicted_logits, sum_exp_logits, softmax, logits_max
230	
231	        entropy = vocab_parallel_logits.new_zeros((0,))
232	        entropy_softmax = vocab_parallel_logits.new_empty((0,))
233	        sum_softmax_times_logits = vocab_parallel_logits.new_empty((0,))
234	
235	        def sum_softmax_logits(softmax: torch.Tensor, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
236	            if softmax.is_cuda:
237	                # Avoid materializing the full [seq_len, vocab] product buffer.
238	                return torch.einsum("ij,ij->i", softmax, logits).unsqueeze(-1)
239	            return (softmax * logits).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
240	
241	        if log_prob_keep_mask is None:
242	            predicted_logits, log_prob_sum_exp_logits, log_prob_softmax, log_prob_logits_max = vocab_parallel_softmax(
243	                vocab_parallel_logits
244	            )
245	            if with_entropy:
246	                entropy_softmax = log_prob_softmax
247	                sum_softmax_times_logits = sum_softmax_logits(entropy_softmax, vocab_parallel_logits)
248	                _maybe_all_reduce(sum_softmax_times_logits, dist.ReduceOp.SUM, process_group)
249	                entropy = log_prob_logits_max + log_prob_sum_exp_logits.log() - sum_softmax_times_logits
250	                entropy = entropy.squeeze(dim=-1)
251	        else:
252	            if with_entropy:
253	                _entropy_predicted_logits, entropy_sum_exp_logits, entropy_softmax, entropy_logits_max = (
254	                    vocab_parallel_softmax(vocab_parallel_logits)
255	                )
256	                sum_softmax_times_logits = sum_softmax_logits(entropy_softmax, vocab_parallel_logits)
257	                _maybe_all_reduce(sum_softmax_times_logits, dist.ReduceOp.SUM, process_group)
258	                entropy = entropy_logits_max + entropy_sum_exp_logits.log() - sum_softmax_times_logits
259	                entropy = entropy.squeeze(dim=-1)
260	
261	            local_target_rows = torch.nonzero(~target_mask, as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1)
262	            log_prob_logits = vocab_parallel_logits.masked_fill(~log_prob_keep_mask, float("-inf"))
263	            if local_target_rows.numel() > 0:
264	                log_prob_logits[local_target_rows, masked_target_1d[local_target_rows]] = vocab_parallel_logits[
265	                    local_target_rows, masked_target_1d[local_target_rows]
266	                ]
267	            # ``log_prob_logits`` is an owned scratch buffer here, so let the softmax
268	            # consume it in place rather than allocating another copy.
269	            predicted_logits, log_prob_sum_exp_logits, log_prob_softmax, _log_prob_logits_max = vocab_parallel_softmax(
270	                log_prob_logits, inplace=True
271	            )
272	
273	        predicted_logits = predicted_logits.masked_fill_(target_mask, 0.0).unsqueeze(-1)
274	        _maybe_all_reduce(predicted_logits, dist.ReduceOp.SUM, process_group)
275	        log_prob = predicted_logits - log_prob_sum_exp_logits.log()
276	
277	        if not with_entropy_grad:
278	            ctx.mark_non_differentiable(entropy)
279	
280	        ctx.with_entropy_grad = with_entropy_grad
281	        # Metric-only entropy still returns values, but does not need the
282	        # full-vocab entropy tensors kept alive for backward.
283	        saved_entropy_softmax = entropy_softmax if with_entropy_grad else vocab_parallel_logits.new_empty((0,))
284	        saved_sum_softmax_times_logits = (
285	            sum_softmax_times_logits if with_entropy_grad else vocab_parallel_logits.new_empty((0,))
286	        )
287	        saved_logits = vocab_parallel_logits if with_entropy_grad else vocab_parallel_logits.new_empty((0,))
288	        ctx.save_for_backward(
289	            log_prob_softmax,
290	            target_mask,
291	            masked_target_1d,
292	            saved_entropy_softmax,
293	            saved_sum_softmax_times_logits,
294	            saved_logits,
295	        )
296	        return log_prob, entropy

298	    @staticmethod
299	    def backward(
300	        ctx, grad_log_prob: torch.Tensor | None, grad_entropy: torch.Tensor | None
301	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None, None, None, None, None]:
302	        (
303	            log_prob_softmax,
304	            target_mask,
305	            masked_target_1d,
306	            entropy_softmax,
307	            sum_softmax_times_logits,
308	            vocab_parallel_logits,
309	        ) = ctx.saved_tensors
310	
311	        if grad_log_prob is None:
312	            raise RuntimeError(
313	                "_VocabParallelLogProbEntropy expected a materialized grad_log_prob. "
314	                "Do not call ctx.set_materialize_grads(False)."
315	            )
316	
317	        grad_entropy_input = None
318	        if ctx.with_entropy_grad and grad_entropy is not None and grad_entropy.numel() > 0:
319	            # In the unmasked path, entropy_softmax aliases log_prob_softmax.
320	            # Build entropy grad before mutating log_prob_softmax below.
321	            grad_entropy_input = sum_softmax_times_logits - vocab_parallel_logits
322	            grad_entropy_input.mul_(entropy_softmax)
323	            grad_entropy_input.mul_(grad_entropy.reshape(-1, 1))
324	
325	        vocab_parallel_size = log_prob_softmax.size(-1)
326	        grad_input = log_prob_softmax.neg_()
327	        grad_2d = grad_input.view(-1, vocab_parallel_size)
328	        arange_1d = torch.arange(grad_2d.size(0), device=grad_2d.device)
329	        target_update = (~target_mask).to(dtype=grad_2d.dtype)
330	        grad_2d[arange_1d, masked_target_1d] += target_update
331	        grad_input.mul_(grad_log_prob.reshape(-1, 1))
332	
333	        if grad_entropy_input is not None:
334	            grad_input.add_(grad_entropy_input)
335	
336	        return grad_input, None, None, None, None, None

371	def get_reinforce_plus_plus_returns(
372	    rewards: torch.Tensor,
373	    kl: list[torch.Tensor],
374	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
375	    response_lengths: list[int],
376	    total_lengths: list[int],
377	    kl_coef: float,
378	    gamma: float,
379	) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
380	    """
381	    Calculates discounted returns for REINFORCE++ (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.03262)
382	
383	    Args:
384	        rewards (Tensor): A tensor of scalar rewards for each sequence.
385	        kl (List[Tensor]): List of per-token KL divergence tensors for sequence chunks.
386	        loss_masks (List[Tensor]): List of response-only loss masks for each full sequence.
387	        response_lengths (List[int]): The full length of each response sequence.
388	        total_lengths (List[int]): The full length of each sequence (prompt + response).
389	        kl_coef (float): Coefficient for the KL penalty.
390	        gamma (float): The discount factor.
391	
392	    Returns:
393	        List[torch.Tensor]: A list of return (G_t) tensors for the
394	                            local sequence chunks owned by the current GPU rank.
395	    """
396	    from megatron.core import mpu
397	
398	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
399	
400	    token_level_rewards = []
401	    for i in range(len(rewards)):
402	        local_kl_chunk = kl[i]
403	        total_len, response_len = total_lengths[i], response_lengths[i]
404	
405	        if cp_size > 1:
406	            # Step 1,2:Gather all chunks and token_offsets from all ranks and reconstruct the full response tensor by splitting and placing each part
407	            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.cp_utils import all_gather_with_cp
408	
409	            full_kl_response = all_gather_with_cp(local_kl_chunk, total_len, response_len)
410	        else:
411	            full_kl_response = local_kl_chunk
412	
413	        # Step 3: Compute returns on full response kl tensor.
414	        full_mask = loss_masks[i]
415	        assert full_mask.sum().item() > 0, f"Sequence at index {i} is fully masked."
416	        masked_kl = full_kl_response * full_mask
417	        rewards_for_seq = -kl_coef * masked_kl
418	        last_idx = full_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0][-1]
419	        rewards_for_seq[last_idx] += rewards[i]
420	        token_level_rewards.append(rewards_for_seq)
421	
422	    if not token_level_rewards:
423	        return []
424	
425	    max_len = max(rewards_for_seq.size(0) for rewards_for_seq in token_level_rewards)
426	    padded_rewards = token_level_rewards[0].new_zeros(len(token_level_rewards), max_len)
427	    for i, rewards_for_seq in enumerate(token_level_rewards):
428	        padded_rewards[i, : rewards_for_seq.size(0)] = rewards_for_seq
429	
430	    padded_returns = chunked_discounted_returns(padded_rewards, gamma)
431	
432	    final_returns_chunks = []
433	    for i, returns_for_seq in enumerate(padded_returns):
434	        returns_for_seq = returns_for_seq[: token_level_rewards[i].size(0)]
435	        if cp_size > 1:
436	            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.cp_utils import slice_log_prob_with_cp
437	
438	            total_len, response_len = total_lengths[i], response_lengths[i]
439	            local_returns_chunk = slice_log_prob_with_cp(returns_for_seq, total_len, response_len)
440	        else:
441	            local_returns_chunk = returns_for_seq
442	
443	        final_returns_chunks.append(local_returns_chunk)
444	
445	    return final_returns_chunks

448	def get_reinforce_plus_plus_baseline_advantages(
449	    rewards: torch.Tensor,
450	    kl: list[torch.Tensor],
451	    kl_coef: float,
452	) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
453	    """
454	    Calculates the unwhitened advantages for the REINFORCE++-baseline algorithm.
455	    Broadcasting the scalar (reward - group_baseline) to each token.
456	
457	    Args:
458	        rewards (Tensor): A tensor of scalar rewards, where the group-wise
459	                                baseline has already been subtracted.
460	        kl (list[Tensor]): A list of per-token KL divergence tensors. Used to
461	                                 get the shape for broadcasting.
462	        kl_coef (float): Coefficient for the KL penalty.
463	
464	    Returns:
465	        list[Tensor]: A list of tensors containing the unwhitened advantages.
466	    """
467	    # Broadcast to get unwhitened advantages
468	    unwhitened_advantages = [
469	        torch.ones_like(kl_tensor) * reward_val - kl_coef * kl_tensor
470	        for kl_tensor, reward_val in zip(kl, rewards, strict=False)
471	    ]
472	
473	    return unwhitened_advantages

476	def get_advantages_and_returns_batch(
477	    total_lengths,
478	    response_lengths,
479	    values_list,
480	    rewards_list,
481	    gamma,
482	    lambd,
483	    chunked: bool = True,
484	):
485	    """
486	    Batched GAE with CP support.
487	    Input:
488	        total_lengths:     list[int], each sample's total_len
489	        response_lengths:  list[int], each sample's response_len
490	        values_list:       list[Tensor], each shape = [resp_len_i]
491	        rewards_list:      list[Tensor], same shape
492	    Output:
493	        advantages_list:   list[Tensor], each shape = [resp_len_i]
494	        returns_list:      list[Tensor], same shape
495	    """
496	
497	    from megatron.core import mpu
498	
499	    with torch.no_grad():
500	        B = len(response_lengths)
501	        assert B == len(values_list)
502	        assert B == len(rewards_list)
503	
504	        cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
505	        device = values_list[0].device
506	        dtype = values_list[0].dtype
507	
508	        if cp_size > 1:
509	            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.cp_utils import all_gather_with_cp
510	
511	            full_values_list = []
512	            full_rewards_list = []
513	
514	            for total_len, resp_len, v, r in zip(
515	                total_lengths, response_lengths, values_list, rewards_list, strict=False
516	            ):
517	                full_v = all_gather_with_cp(v, total_len, resp_len)
518	                full_r = all_gather_with_cp(r, total_len, resp_len)
519	                full_values_list.append(full_v)
520	                full_rewards_list.append(full_r)
521	
522	            # full_values_list[i].shape = [total_len_i]
523	        else:
524	            full_values_list = values_list
525	            full_rewards_list = rewards_list
526	
527	        # pad to max_len for batched GAE
528	        max_len = max(response_lengths)
529	
530	        full_values = torch.zeros(B, max_len, device=device, dtype=dtype)
531	        full_rewards = torch.zeros(B, max_len, device=device, dtype=dtype)
532	
533	        for i in range(B):
534	            L = response_lengths[i]
535	            full_values[i, :L] = full_values_list[i][:L]
536	            full_rewards[i, :L] = full_rewards_list[i][:L]
537	
538	        if not chunked:
539	            full_advantages, full_returns = vanilla_gae(
540	                rewards=full_rewards,
541	                values=full_values,
542	                gamma=gamma,
543	                lambd=lambd,
544	            )
545	        else:
546	            full_advantages, full_returns = chunked_gae(
547	                rewards=full_rewards,
548	                values=full_values,
549	                gamma=gamma,
550	                lambd=lambd,
551	            )
552	
553	        advantages_list = []
554	        returns_list = []
555	
556	        if cp_size > 1:
557	            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.cp_utils import slice_log_prob_with_cp
558	
559	            for total_len, resp_len, adv_row, ret_row in zip(
560	                total_lengths,
561	                response_lengths,
562	                full_advantages,
563	                full_returns,
564	                strict=False,
565	            ):
566	                adv_full = adv_row  # shape = [resp_len_i padded to max_len]
567	                ret_full = ret_row
568	
569	                adv_sliced = slice_log_prob_with_cp(adv_full[:resp_len], total_len, resp_len)
570	                ret_sliced = slice_log_prob_with_cp(ret_full[:resp_len], total_len, resp_len)
571	
572	                advantages_list.append(adv_sliced)
573	                returns_list.append(ret_sliced)
574	
575	        else:
576	            for i in range(B):
577	                L = response_lengths[i]
578	                advantages_list.append(full_advantages[i, :L])
579	                returns_list.append(full_returns[i, :L])
580	
581	    return advantages_list, returns_list

584	def vanilla_gae(
585	    rewards: torch.Tensor,
586	    values: torch.Tensor,
587	    gamma: float,
588	    lambd: float,
589	):
590	    B, T = rewards.shape
591	    device = rewards.device
592	    dtype = rewards.dtype
593	
594	    lastgaelam = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=dtype)
595	    adv_rev = []
596	
597	    for t in reversed(range(T)):
598	        next_value = values[:, t + 1] if t < T - 1 else 0.0
599	        delta = rewards[:, t] + gamma * next_value - values[:, t]
600	        lastgaelam = delta + gamma * lambd * lastgaelam
601	        adv_rev.append(lastgaelam)
602	
603	    full_advantages = torch.stack(adv_rev[::-1], dim=1)  # [B, max_len]
604	    full_returns = full_advantages + values  # [B, max_len]
605	    return full_advantages, full_returns

608	def chunked_discounted_returns(
609	    rewards: torch.Tensor,
610	    discount: float,
611	    chunk_size: int = 128,
612	) -> torch.Tensor:
613	    """
614	    Compute discounted returns using a parallel scan within fixed-size chunks.
615	
616	    This reduces the sequential dependency length from O(T) to O(T / chunk_size),
617	    while keeping chunk computations fully parallelizable (O(C^2) per chunk).
618	
619	    Args:
620	        rewards (Tensor): [B, T] reward sequence.
621	        discount (float): Discount factor applied at each step.
622	        chunk_size (int): sequence chunk length for parallel scan.
623	
624	    Returns:
625	        Tensor: [B, T] discounted returns.
626	    """
627	    assert rewards.ndim == 2
628	    B, T = rewards.shape
629	
630	    device = rewards.device
631	    dtype = rewards.dtype
632	
633	    # Reformulate the backward recurrence as a forward scan on the reversed
634	    # sequence: S[i] = rewards[i] + discount * S[i - 1].
635	    rewards_rev = torch.flip(rewards, dims=[1])
636	
637	    if T % chunk_size != 0:
638	        pad = chunk_size - (T % chunk_size)
639	        rewards_rev = F.pad(rewards_rev, (0, pad))
640	    else:
641	        pad = 0
642	
643	    B, T_pad = rewards_rev.shape
644	    n_chunks = T_pad // chunk_size
645	    rewards_chunks = rewards_rev.view(B, n_chunks, chunk_size)
646	
647	    idx = torch.arange(chunk_size, device=device)
648	    row = idx[:, None]
649	    col = idx[None, :]
650	    diff = col - row
651	
652	    M = torch.zeros(chunk_size, chunk_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)
653	    mask = diff >= 0
654	
655	    if discount == 0.0:
656	        M[mask & (diff == 0)] = 1.0
657	    else:
658	        M[mask] = discount ** diff[mask].to(dtype)
659	
660	    if discount == 0.0:
661	        pow_vec = torch.zeros(chunk_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)
662	    else:
663	        pow_vec = discount ** torch.arange(1, chunk_size + 1, device=device, dtype=dtype)
664	
665	    rewards_flat = rewards_chunks.reshape(B * n_chunks, chunk_size)
666	    S_local_flat = rewards_flat @ M
667	    S_local_chunks = S_local_flat.view(B, n_chunks, chunk_size)
668	
669	    lengths = [chunk_size] * n_chunks
670	    if pad > 0:
671	        lengths[-1] = chunk_size - pad
672	
673	    S_rev = rewards_rev.new_zeros(B, T_pad)
674	    s_prev = torch.zeros(B, device=device, dtype=dtype)
675	
676	    for c in range(n_chunks):
677	        Lc = lengths[c]
678	        start = c * chunk_size
679	        end = start + Lc
680	
681	        S_local = S_local_chunks[:, c, :Lc]
682	        S_global = S_local + s_prev.unsqueeze(1) * pow_vec[:Lc]
683	
684	        S_rev[:, start:end] = S_global
685	        s_prev = S_global[:, -1]
686	
687	    if pad > 0:
688	        S_rev = S_rev[:, :T]
689	
690	    return torch.flip(S_rev, dims=[1])
691

693	def chunked_gae(
